summary: Ubisoft and Red Storm's tactical counter-terrorism shooter series, spanning the original planning-heavy PC games, expansions, console side games, Vegas, Siege, Extraction, and mobile spin-offs.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six

primary.why: The original was PC-first and remains the most complete tactical/planning route; later console/handheld ports are adaptations.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with compatibility fixes; sample Dreamcast/N64/PlayStation/Game Boy Color only for port comparison.

secondary.exclusive_content: Handheld adaptation of the first game.
secondary.why: It is a distinct scaled-down version.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Eagle Watch

primary.why: Eagle Watch is the Windows expansion to the original game and is best preserved with the PC base game.
primary.how_to_play: Install on Windows after Rainbow Six; use console ports only for comparison.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Rogue Spear

primary.why: Rogue Spear is PC-first and Windows is the most complete and configurable version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with compatibility fixes; preserve console/handheld ports separately only for version comparison.

secondary.why: It is a distinct reduced version.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Rogue Spear - Urban Operations

primary.why: Urban Operations is the Windows expansion to Rogue Spear and is best preserved on PC.
primary.how_to_play: Install on Windows with Rogue Spear; Dreamcast content is port context only.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Covert Ops Essentials

primary.why: Covert Ops Essentials is a standalone Windows expansion/training package, so Windows is the only verified route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Windows with compatibility fixes.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Rogue Spear - Black Thorn

primary.why: Black Thorn is a standalone Windows expansion in the Rogue Spear line.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Windows with compatibility fixes.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Take-Down - Missions in Korea

primary.why: Take-Down was a Windows-only South Korean standalone release and should be preserved as its own regional game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release if a legally preserved copy is available; document Korean release build.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Lone Wolf

primary.why: Lone Wolf is PlayStation-exclusive; DuckStation upscaling is the best preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation release in DuckStation or on original hardware.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3: Raven Shield

primary.why: Raven Shield is the PC Rainbow Six 3 entry and Windows is the most complete tactical route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with compatibility fixes; console Rainbow Six 3/Black Arrow are separate console routes.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3: Athena Sword

primary.why: Athena Sword is the Raven Shield expansion and is best played on Windows.
primary.how_to_play: Install with Raven Shield on Windows.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3: Black Arrow

emulation.notes: Use Xbox emulation or original hardware.

primary.why: Black Arrow is Xbox-only, so original Xbox hardware or xemu is the route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox hardware or xemu.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3: Iron Wrath

primary.why: Iron Wrath is a Windows downloadable expansion for Raven Shield.
primary.how_to_play: Install with Raven Shield on Windows.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Broken Wings

primary.why: Broken Wings is documented as a mobile-only Rainbow Six entry; preservation depends on original mobile builds.
primary.how_to_play: Archive only with a verified mobile build/device profile.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Urban Crisis

primary.why: Urban Crisis is documented as a mobile-only Rainbow Six entry; preservation depends on original mobile builds.
primary.how_to_play: Archive only with a verified mobile build/device profile.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Lockdown

primary.why: The Windows release is the highest-fidelity route for Lockdown despite arriving after the console versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Windows with compatibility fixes; use Xbox/PS2/GameCube/mobile only for version comparison.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Critical Hour

emulation.notes: Use Xbox emulation or original hardware.

primary.why: Critical Hour is Xbox-only, so original hardware or xemu is the route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox hardware or xemu.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; PPSSPP optional for PSP adaptation.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity route for Vegas and its tactical-cover reboot style.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with compatibility fixes; use PSP/mobile only for adaptation comparison.

secondary.why: It is a distinct reduced portable route.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas 2

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity route for Vegas 2.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with compatibility fixes.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Shadow Vanguard

primary.why: Shadow Vanguard is a mobile remake/adaptation of the original game, and Android is the most flexible preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a documented Android build; iOS/Xperia Play are equivalent mobile routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile remake/adaptation of the original Rainbow Six.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege

primary.version: Current PC build / Siege X era
primary.why: Siege is an online live-service tactical shooter; Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route, while PS5/Series X/S are strong console routes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build; document season, Siege X/free-access state, operator roster, and cross-progression status.

entries.remaster_caveats: Siege evolved into the Siege X era; record current season and service state.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Extraction

primary.why: Extraction is a cross-play co-op spin-off from Siege's Outbreak mode; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release; document cross-play/service state and post-launch content.

entries.title: Rainbow Six: SMOL

emulation.notes: Use only with documented app/account state.

primary.why: SMOL was a Netflix mobile release and is no longer available, so Android is the more flexible preservation route if a verified build/account state exists.
primary.how_to_play: No normal current route; archive only with documented Netflix/app version state.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mobile

primary.why: Rainbow Six Mobile is Android/iOS only, and Android is the most flexible route for versioned preservation and emulator testing.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Android release or preserve a documented app version; record region/season/service state.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Patriots

primary.why: Patriots was canceled and has no playable release/platform route to recommend.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a play route unless a released or preserved playable build is verified.

entries.remaster_caveats: Canceled project; keep as needs-research placeholder.
